system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Sentinel-1 acquisition footprints over the Boro watershed and its immediate floodplain.

data_description.temporal_coverage: 2014-10-01 to present, subject to catalog holdings at evaluation time.
analytical_capabilities: Retrieve Sentinel-1 VV and VH backscatter observations for flood-event windows
Construct pre-event to flood-event change metrics and flood-inundation classifications
Assess flood extent against independently collected local validation evidence when available

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Calibrated Sentinel-1 ground-range-detected SAR backscatter in decibels.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use COPERNICUS/S1_GRD with a consistent instrument mode, orbit pass and polarization. Create comparable pre-event and event composites, mask permanent water where appropriate, and treat a derived flood map as a Sentinel-1 product rather than as a separate required source.

data_description.data_source: Copernicus Sentinel-1 mission, distributed through Google Earth Engine
